verdict.rationale: Plaid Identity Verification is a verification/KYC SaaS API, not an AI agent or assistant that itself consumes external tools via MCP; the evidence shows Plaid offers an MCP server (docs/resources/mcp) exposing its own APIs, which is the reverse (server) role, not the client-side 'plug MCP servers in so it can use their tools' capability this story asks about. This axis is a category error for a non-agentic verification product.
